w: A large Swaminarayan Mantra rally was carried out on the main streets of Surendranagar from 5.00 p.m. More than 2,500 devotees chanted the Swaminarayan Mantra under the auspices of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebration to be held in 2002. The rally concluded into an assembly on the mandir grounds.

At 12.00 noon, Swamishri, sadhus, the Indian Ambassador H.E. Surindersingh Gill and leading devotees arrived at the Government House in Manama city. Swamishri was led to the Private Office of the Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa Bin Salman Al Khalifa. After the welcome formalities by the Prime Minister and his cabinet ministers, namely, Minister of Foreign affairs, Cabinet Affairs, Information & Broadcasting, Interior, State, Environment and Housing; a dialogue, with Brahmavihari Swami as the interpreter, took place between the Sheikh and Swamishri. Sheikh : We are happy to welcome you in Bahrain. I know you have been received and honored by many leaders throughout the world, and are held in high respect. It shows what place you occupy in people's hearts. Swamishri : It is all due to God's grace. We are all His instruments and serve society according to His will. Sheikh : I am aware of the good relation you shared with our late Highness Sheikh Isa, and I hope you extend your stay in Bahrain for several more days. Your presence and work bring peace and this is very important in today's world... They are our friends. Swamishri : ... We are pleased by your love for India and Gujarat. Sheikh : I have seen a photo of the London Mandir. It is a wonderful monument. Amazing! A lot of effort has gone into its creation. Throughout, there is peace and divinity in it. I believe whatever that is done with faith and love, with the united efforts of so many people succeeds in creating peace. It seems what Swami has done, has been done by God.

The Sheikh was all praises for the spirit of volunteerism behind the creation of the mandir in London. The BAPS earthquake relief work impressed him further. On hearing about Swamishri's message of peace at the Peace Summit in UN and personal meeting with Mr. Kofi Annan, the Sheikh opined, "I offer my good wishes to Swamiji and wherever you go, may you be successful. Whoever provides the needs of people, is great in this world!" While going through a brochure on Akshardham monument the Sheikh was amazed and inquired of its details. In conclusion, the Sheikh said, "Forgive me for spending only a little time with you. But when I come to India I will come with enough time. Today is one of my busiest of days ... But still, I can always spare time for friends." Swamishri then conveyed his good wishes and blessings for the King of Bahrain - Sheikh Hamad and the entire country. Swamishri presented an Amrut Kalash to the Prime Minister. After a group photo session, the Prime Minister saw Swamishri to the steps of the Cabinet House. The 24 minute dialogue was cordial and memorable.

The evening public assembly was arranged at the hall in Sheraton Hotel. A kirtan-bhakti program enthralled the audience. The Indian Consul General, Shri Rajiv Sahare, welcomed Swamishri with a garland and addressed the assembly. After Swamishri's blessings, the kirtan-bhakti program continued.

At 5.50 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Ambardi - the birthplace of Jaga Swami. After performing pujan and arti of Thakorji, Swamishri spoke about Jaga Swami's faith in Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and his tolerant nature. Thereafter Swamishri went for darshan of the birthplace of Jaga Swami.
At 6.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Bhadhada village. After performing pujan and arti of the deities in the Swaminarayan hari mandir he blessed the assembly and departed for Savarkundla.

At 7.15 p.m. Swamishri was welcomed by devotees and officials of the local municipality in Rajula. After the welcome dance by satsangi children and teenagers of Rajula, Swamishri blessed the assembly of 7,000 devotees and aspirants.

At 9.45 a.m. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha Krishna Dev, Guru Parampara, Shri Hanumanji and Shri Ganapatiji at the hari mandir in Rajula. After performing arti, Swamishri addressed an assembly of 7,000 devotees and wellwishers.
A mandir guard, named Ashwin, asked Swamishri, “Sometimes I feel unhappy and sometimes happy. What should I do?”
“Bhajan. When you are happy do bhajan and when unhappy, again do bhajan.”
Swamishri prescribed the highest and the best means to remain balanced in life.
During the meetings, a devotee came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He has a mobile phone agency. His son was with him. The devotee said, "This son looks after the mobile phone agency."

Swamishri ran his hand around his own neck and said, "Where is your kanthi (sacred neck beads)?" In fact, he was not wearing one. Swamishri immediately said, "Just as you constantly keep your mobile safe in your pocket, keep the kanthi safe around your neck too. The kanthi is even greater than the mobile. So especially take care of your kanthi and your satsang, go to the mandir regularly and attend the Sunday assembly too."

During the Sunday Satsang assembly Swamishri blessed the devotees, “With the command of Yogiji Maharaj we are conducting the Sunday assembly in villages and cities. You have all arrived here in this great pilgrim place of Gadhpur. The fruit of the Sunday assembly is that we personally consolidate the knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam within ourselves. We saw the drama of Bhaga Sheth and Shivlal Sheth. Bhaga Sheth was socially and materialistically inclined. Shivlal Sheth, however, was spiritually associated with Gunatitanand Swami so he performed all his worldly duties with the understanding that it was all vainful. So he had peace despite performing his worldly duties. Otherwise, when one becomes absorbed in mundane activities it becomes difficult to come out of it, and subsequently one experiences misery.” After his blessings, Swamishri offered prayers for the successful completion of the Narmada Dam Project and that the prevailing obstacles be resolved.

st.t: ‘Aap Ki Rasoi’ Midday Meal for The Needy
w: Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir, New Delhi, in association with the Delhi Government launched ‘AAP KI RASOI’, a campaign to make Delhi Hunger Free, on 16 April 2008 at the Nizamuddin Night Shelter.The campaign was inaugurated by Smt. Sheila Dikshit, Chief Minister of Delhi.

As there is a big number of destitute who find it extremely difficult to earn even one single meal a day, the Government of Delhi has requested NGOs and corporate houses to provide meals to these people once a day in the afternoon. Nutritious freshly cooked food will be served once a day to about 600 needy people, mainly women and children.

The BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir is the first to start the programme in association with the Delhi Government. The Chief Minister Smt. Sheila Dikshit personally inspected and distributed lunch to many people. Dr. Yoganand Shashtri, Minister of Health, Family Welfare and Social Welfare (Delhi Government) and area Councilor were also present at the launch.

Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt, Speaker of the Legislative Assembly, came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He was very impressed after seeing the water show. Giving his response to the water show, he said, "You have brought Nachiketa of the Vedic age back to life. Science was used for religion in the Vedic age, and after that you have done it for the first time, in the 21st century. In between, science and religion had become two separate wings. You have brought them together. By bringing the two together, one learns the art of living, and moreover one gets not entertainment but inner joy. You have done such beautiful work. I was there on the day of the inauguration. Watching this water show, tears came to my eyes."
Swamishri said, "By God's wish, all these sadhus had the wish to do it."

Ashokbhai said, "It is you who inspire the sadhus, isn't it! Calling the scientists and making the arrangements is your work. Seeing this work of yours, all the other religions and sampradayas now think, what can we do like Akshardham? You have brought about a beautiful revolution in this way. The influence that Shriji Maharaj had is seen in you. Just as Shriji Maharaj lived among the Kathis and brought satsang to the Kathis, which was difficult, so you have brought Hindu culture to life across the seas and created goodwill in everyone. There is a similarity between the two."

Swamishri said, "It is Jogi Bapa's (Yogiji Maharaj's) wish and Shriji Maharaj's blessings. Jogi Bapa always used to chant a dhun that satsang would spread across the universe. So inspiration comes from his wish."

Ashokbhai Bhatt remained absorbed in singing praises. He said, "You have given a new subject called temple management. I believe that a whole book should be written about you. Please give society some inspiration yourself."

He also said, "I am not exaggerating, but whatever there was in the time of Shriji Maharaj is seen now. Along with religion, science, character, health care, social service and spirituality, all of these are seen now."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj sat to offer his meal to Thakorji. Meanwhile Ishwarcharan Swami, Vivekjivan Swami, Shrihari Swami, Brahmavihari Swami and other sadhus gave news of the volcano that had recently erupted in Iceland in Europe. In the context that no one can match God's creation, Vivekjivan Swami said, "God's creation is wonderful. There is a special reason even for the earth turning on its axis at 23 degrees. If the moon were closer than it is now, the whole world would drown in the high and low tides, and if the sun were closer, the whole earth would be burnt to ashes. So, as in Vachanamrut Gadhada I 27, whatever infinite powers there are, all are yours."
At that moment Swamishri was eating khichdi with a spoon. So he said, "Right now I can only eat with a spoon."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "It is written in the Vachanamrut that God walks on his feet (in human form). The words of Shriji Maharaj that are written must be true, mustn't they?"

Swamishri said, "But it has to be understood and believed, doesn't it? Otherwise it becomes, 'This happened to me and that happened to me.' We do say, 'Everything belongs to God,' but when the time comes we forget it."
Vivekjivan Swami said, "That is why you have come to earth and give people like us awareness."
Swamishri said, "God is the all doer and he does good to everyone. That alone is to be understood."

In the Sunday assembly today, Mahant Swami Maharaj showered very beautiful blessings, saying:

"If one gives up one's faults of nature, Akshardham is right here... If one understands the form of Maharaj and Swami, nothing remains. If we grab each fault of nature by the tuft of hair and go at it with all our might, it will go. Keep the target 'I want to become ekantik'; otherwise we will just keep wandering. Start from anywhere, from Ahmedabad, from Rajkot or from Nadiad; but in the end everyone has to reach Akshardham. Whatever fumbling we do, Maharaj turns it into ekantik devotion. Maharaj has made countless ekantik devotees, and it is still going on today."
